title: Scientific Image Synthesis: Benchmarking, Methodologies, and Downstream Utility
abstract: arXiv:2601.17027v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While synthetic data has proven effective for improving scientific reasoning in the text domain, multimodal reasoning remains constrained by the difficulty of synthesizing scientifically rigorous images. Existing Text-to-Image (T2I) models often produce outputs that are visually plausible yet scientifically incorrect, resulting in a persistent visual-logic divergence that limits their value for downstream reasoning. Motivated by recent advances in next-generation T2I models, we conduct a systematic study of scientific image synthesis across generation paradigms, evaluation, and downstream use. We analyze both direct pixel-based generation and programmatic synthesis, and propose ImgCoder, a logic-driven framework that follows an explicit "understand - plan - code" workflow to improve structural precision. To rigorously assess scientific correctness, we introduce SciGenBench, which evaluates generated images based on information

translated_title: 科学图像合成：基准测试、方法论与下游应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.17027v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：虽然合成数据已被证明在文本领域能有效提升科学推理能力，但多模态推理仍受限于合成科学严谨图像的难度。现有的文本到图像（T2I）模型通常生成视觉上合理但科学上不正确的输出，导致持续的视觉-逻辑分歧，限制了其在下游推理中的价值。受最新一代T2I模型进展的启发，我们对科学图像合成进行了系统性研究，涵盖生成范式、评估和下游应用。我们分析了直接基于像素的生成和程序化合成，并提出了ImgCoder，一个逻辑驱动的框架，遵循显式的“理解-规划-编码”工作流，以提高结构精度。为了严格评估科学正确性，我们引入了SciGenBench，它基于信息内容来评估生成图像。
tldr: 本文提出了ImgCoder框架和SciGenBench基准，通过逻辑驱动的“理解-规划-编码”流程和基于信息的评估方法，解决了科学图像合成中视觉与逻辑不一致的问题，从而提升科学推理的多模态能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the ImgCoder framework and SciGenBench benchmark, addressing visual-logic divergence in scientific image synthesis via a logic-driven "understand-plan-code" workflow and information-based evaluation to enhance multimodal scientific reasoning.
